_meta.provenance: Each case renders one official example fragment VERBATIM (installed-file sha256 verified against the audit on 2026-07-12). The defects are organic: they exist in the reference artifact itself, not injected by the corpus authors.
_meta.pooling_rule: NEVER pooled with the injected-corpus metrics — this suite answers external validity (does the validator catch defects in the canonical artifact it learned from?), the injected suite answers the controlled differential claim (D-13).
_meta.tc_f_11_overlap: The 2 wizard cases (TC-O-05/06) share the broken-aria-labelledby MECHANISM with injected case TC-F-11: an aria-labelledby attribute referencing a nonexistent id ('info5' here, 'ghost-label-id' there). The cited norms differ by context — TC-F-11 is a form label (emag:6.2), the wizard buttons are widget accessible names (wcag:4.1.2). Detection of one predicts detection of the other; report the overlap when discussing results.
_meta.observed_beyond_audit: MEASURED 2026-07-12: axe additionally reports color-contrast VIOLATIONS (4 nodes) on the official card-disabled fragment (TC-O-02) — organic defects beyond the audit's 6 findings. Unadjudicated: the card's disabled state is CSS-only (no disabled attribute), so the WCAG 1.4.3 inactive-component exemption arguably does not apply programmatically. Kept out of the gabarito (which is sourced strictly from the KB audit); cite as an observation.
